description: This file contains unit tests for the Abseil random number generators, specifically testing various distribution functions with different generator types using Google Test framework.

methods.name: TestUniform
methods.description: Tests the absl::Uniform function with various type parameters and interval options.

methods.name: TestExponential
methods.description: Tests the absl::Exponential distribution function with float and double types.

methods.name: TestPoisson
methods.description: Tests the absl::Poisson distribution function with multiple integer types.

methods.name: TestZipf
methods.description: Tests the absl::Zipf distribution function with various integer types.

methods.name: TestLogNormal
methods.description: Tests the absl::LogUniform distribution function with various integer types.

methods.name: CompatibilityTest
methods.description: Runs all distribution tests with a specified generator type.
